findings.title: FileCredentialReader converts a JWT exp date to milliseconds with a trapping Int64(Double) conversion
findings.evidence: Int64(date.timeIntervalSince1970 * 1000) traps when a JWT exp is huge (e.g. 1e300); raised by Cético B while verifying BEST-ATE-003.
findings.impact: Crash on a malformed local auth.json token; input is a user-owned CLI file, so LOW.
findings.fix: Guard isFinite and range, or use Int64(exactly:) with a fallback.

findings.title: SettingsViewModel.reloadFromDisk doc comment is false: original is a let and only draft is replaced
findings.evidence: Raised by Cético C while verifying VERB-LAC-006: original is declared let (:27), reloadFromDisk only replaces draft (:58), so wiring it as documented would leave hasUnsavedChanges true.
findings.fix: Delete the dead method (VERB-LAC-006) or fix both the doc and the implementation.
